parole.testo: Inherited from Old Swedish gigha. Derived from Low German gige. Possibly derived from Old High German gigen (“rock, sway”). First attested in the latter 13th century.
Borrowed through Low German hütte, from Old High German hutta.

parole.significato: glue; substance used to make things stick, as a way of attaching a surface to another.
